sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def eyes():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            bb=n['boundary']; rr=[p[0] for p in bb]; cc=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((min(rr),min(cc)))
    return sorted(out)
seq=['RIGHT','UP','RIGHT','UP','RIGHT']
for mv in seq:
    action([mv])
    r=last_action_result
    print(mv, eyes(), 'DONE' if (r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over')) else '')
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('game_over'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
